# IconButton

Perform an action with a single click.
See [Button guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/button/design/)

To setup Airbus or Material Icons see <LinkTo kind="General/Visual Styles/Icons" story="docs">Visual Styles/Icons</LinkTo>
